resources.string: Lets your organisation confirm this device is managed and lock it remotely. On company-owned (fully managed) devices it can also erase the device and enforce screen-lock and camera rules. On personal devices it never erases data or changes those settings.

Lets your IT support tap, swipe and type on this screen during a screen-sharing session that you approve, and only if you choose "Share screen and allow control" for that session. A red "Remote control active" bar and notification are shown the whole time, with a Stop control button. It does nothing outside such a session and does not collect, store or send screen content, typing or accessibility events. Screen sharing works without it.
Shows that this device is connected to your organisation.
Alerts you when an administrator asks to view your screen.
Shown for as long as your screen is being shared.
Messages from your IT support team.
